top.line: Three sites by hand, then one by a commit: live over https in 87 seconds, a first version at 159.
top.para: A Wardley map moment, and the long list of what it took.

in-short.line: By hand then by commit, every part automated, commoditisation, a hard setup, a wide grant.

story.line: The factory was built in stages on 15 November; three sites were made by hand after midnight.
story.para: QA-1 found a DNS race; QA-2 went live with a first pass in under three minutes.

flow.line: The RiskMandate at Web Summit request: merge at 03:44:06, https at 03:45:33, first version at 03:46:45.
flow.para: Every step written back to status.json.

wardley.line: Every part of a website was already a product or utility; the assembly was custom, and now it is a commit.
wardley.para: The interesting work moves up to the brief and the team.

setup.line: A GitHub App, AWS through OIDC, Claude through federation, environments, and six things that broke.
setup.para: Good security, but it felt like surgery: the technology is still immature.

unlocks.line: Repositories, DNS and AWS changes are now programmatic: variations of the same thing from here.
unlocks.para: What makes the £500 cell sellable at scale.

limits.line: Four factory sites so far, two tests; times from status files; public sites only; a wide grant.

sources.line: The AgentiCCells factory, template and site repositories, and the live sites.
